editorial:
Imagine starting your honeymoon with a nightmare. You follow Andrew and Cynthia, a happy couple whose lives are flipped upside down after a bad run-in with a mean strip club owner. Things go south fast when some thugs attack them, killing the husband and leaving the wife for dead. But Cynthia doesn't die; instead, she loses her grip on reality. She finds a mannequin and starts believing it is her dead husband. The vibe is a wild mix of a scary thriller and a weird character study, making you wonder if she is truly gone or just trying to survive a world that wants her dead.

What really works here is the way the movie shifts from a sad story into a bloody fight for survival. The action gets intense as the hitmen come back to finish the job, and seeing Cynthia fight back while talking to a plastic doll is honestly pretty gripping. It is not a high-budget film, so some parts feel a bit clunky, but that just adds to the old-school charm. If you love weird 90s gems, you should definitely track this down. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the gore in detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a final, bloody showdown where Cynthia has to face the thugs one last time. She fully embraces her violent side to protect herself and her mannequin husband. In the end, she manages to kill the people who ruined her life. While she wins the fight, she remains mentally broken, showing that she will never truly get over her loss, even though the bad guys are finally gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird 90s thrillers and revenge stories.
